verdict.rationale: Token2 makes hardware security keys, so FIPS 140 / Common Criteria certification and durability ratings are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack only covers management tools: companion apps, fido2-manage, the PIV miniDriver and Entra enrollment. The certified-authenticator lookup in the FIDO2 demo searches any vendor's authenticators and does not show that Token2 holds FIPS or Common Criteria certification. Nothing documents water or crush resistance.
